name: Suzuki RMX450Z
intro: An off-road version of the RM-Z450 with lights and an 18-inch rear wheel.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Suzuki dealer to run the VIN as well.
